title: Oh Tree Tree Tree, No Need to Leave
statement: In this two-run communication problem, Isabel encodes a 2030-bit string into the 2047 node bits of a height-11 complete binary tree (17 spare bits), and an adaptive adversary flips one node and swaps its subtrees. A Hamming-style error-correcting code works: XOR syndrome where each node's weight is its depth plus its root-to-node turns at fixed bit positions, so the swap disturbs only the bit after the flipped node's path.
